MISSION WAR WARNING
SITUATION OPAREA: Oyashio current. A Victor III boat is tightening its counter-search as the war warning takes effect.
MISSION Destroy the Victor III and withdraw.
EXECUTION Track the Victor III through the counter-search, break contact when the objective is complete, and withdraw.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT Hostilities are authorized after the warning; preserve the flagship and avoid unnecessary engagements.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. Companion losses do not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
